candidates.text: The design system uses Tailwind v4 tokens for all component styling.
Секреты хранятся в OS keyring и достаются через secret CLI, значения никогда не печатаются.
Feature flags are read from a local flags.json file at startup.
Use pnpm, not npm, when installing JS dependencies.
We run our test suite with pytest.
Python dependencies are managed with uv.
Tests run with pytest; integration tests additionally require the -m integration marker.
Transactional email goes through Resend, specifically the EU region endpoint.
Deploys happen manually on Fridays, though hotfixes may ship any day.
Production has moved off Vercel — it now runs on Fly.io.
The app now stores its data in Postgres; SQLite is no longer used.
We switched from ruff to biome for linting.
